updates.title: Up next: Learn to Play Winter Session registration is open
updates.body: The Winter Session runs eight Saturdays in January and February at LaHaye Ice Center. Your child doesn't need to have done the Fall Session. The dates and the registration link are on the Learn to Play page.

updates.title: Learn to Play Fall Session registration is closed
updates.body: Fall Session registration closed September 20. The Fall Session runs eight Saturday mornings, 8:15 to 9:15: September 26, October 3, 10, 17, 24, November 7, December 5, and December 12. No sessions October 31, November 14, 21, or 28. Full gear is required from day one. The Winter Session is up next. Its dates and registration link are on the Learn to Play page.

updates.title: John Anderson voted onto the LYHA board as Head of Learn to Play
updates.body: The LYHA board voted John Anderson in as Head of Learn to Play. He oversees the program where most Coyotes get their first season on ice.
